description: Current US self-pay GLP-1 prices of one seller, such as Ro, Hims & Hers, LillyDirect or Wellmedr, ranked by cost per 30 days. Only prices that state the supply they buy are ranked. Returns each product, cost per 30 days, the seller's own price wording, the check date, the source page and the seller's page on GLPcompare.
name: find_seller_glp1_prices
title: Find a seller's GLP-1 prices
